title: Why do prime numbers make these spirals? | Dirichlet’s theorem and pi approximations
summary: 3Blue1Brown explains why plotting primes in polar coordinates produces spiral patterns, using modular arithmetic, Dirichlet's theorem and rational approximations of pi.
why: Frequently recommended as the clearest explanation of prime spirals and the Ulam spiral.

quote.text: Here is one of the most enlightening explanations for these kinds of spirals I have seen by 3blue1brown
